data.body: [P1] `@Inherited` automatically opts every existing `ExecutionOtelPlugin`/`InvocationOtelPlugin` subclass into this hook. A subclass compiled against the previous release may already declare an unrelated public `openHandlerScope()`; after upgrading, reflective virtual dispatch invokes that method and closes its resource around every handler. The new superclass method can also shadow an unrelated interface default. Make opt-in explicit on the actual hook method or use a collision-resistant non-virtual bridge, and add an old-compiled OTel-subclass regression test.
